topic: Minimality of continuous invariant parity-odd variables for four-particle events with two interchangeable pairs
title: The §2.9 conjecture of Lester, Haddadin and Gripaios (arXiv:2008.05206v6): three parity-odd variables are necessary

creators.name: Wenlin Zhang
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: We prove the conjecture in §2.9 of Lester, Haddadin and Gripaios, Lorentz and permutation invariants of particles III (arXiv:2008.05206v6), that their three-variable sets S and S-hat are minimal for their respective four-particle event classes. Any two continuous, Lorentz- and pair-permutation-invariant, parity-odd real variables vanish together on a chiral collision event. The proof constructs a sphere consisting entirely of chiral events, on which parity acts antipodally up to the allowed symmetries, and applies the two-dimensional Borsuk-Ulam theorem. The same obstruction holds for strictly timelike, momentum-completable collisions with any number of additional interchangeable momenta, and for fully interchangeable collections of at least four momenta.
summary: The exact minimum is three for both four-momentum domains. Written corollaries establish a lower bound of three for any permutation subgroup containing a transposition on at least four momenta, including fully interchangeable collections and two blocks of sizes at least two. Small timelike markers preserve momentum completion for all S2 × Sn collision classes. A continuous complex scalar also has a chiral zero; the labeled four-momentum case instead admits the single determinant variable. Five-momentum exact minima and fixed-mass variants are not determined.
